program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14, 10, 20),       # diff-pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.5, 0.5, 2.0),    # diff-pair L
    "Itail": (40e-6, 20e-6, 80e-6),
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),    # PMOS mirror load + 2nd-stage driver L
    "gmidp": (10, 7, 14),        # PMOS load/driver gm/Id
    "I7":    (300e-6, 150e-6, 400e-6),
    "Ln":    (1.5, 0.5, 2.0),    # NMOS current-source L
    "gmidn": (12, 8, 15),        # NMOS current-source gm/Id
    "Cc":    (2.5e-12, 1e-12, 4e-12),
    "kz":    (3.0, 1.0, 6.0),    # Rz = kz/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6); vdd = 1.8
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    Id1 = It / 2
    # NMOS bias mirror (ibias diode), tail, 2nd-stage sink
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # differential pair (source at ~0.25 V)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Id1, vds=0.7, vsb=0.25)
    # PMOS mirror load and 2nd-stage driver (same L, gm/Id -> matched Vsg)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Id1, vds=0.8)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)
    Rz = p["kz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # vinp drives the non-diode side x -> non-inverting through PMOS CS
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "dm", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "dm", "dm", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "dm", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "x", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    a1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    C2 = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (C1 * C2 + Cc * (C1 + C2)) / (2 * PI)
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))   # mirror pole (Hz)
    denom = (1.0 / m7.gm - Rz)
    z = 1 / (2 * PI * Cc * max(abs(denom), 1e-6))
    zsign = 1 if denom < 0 else -1   # +1: LHP zero (adds phase)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) \
         - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) \
         + zsign * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z))
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I7)
    swing = (vdd - m7.vdsat - 0.05) - (m8.vdsat + 0.05)
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "power": power, "swing": swing}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller (NMOS pair, PMOS mirror, PMOS CS + nulling R)
